_description: Titles the tailor-resume skill has already researched, mapped to one of the six resume variants. Read by scripts/greenhouse-filter.cjs (pickVariant). Add entries with: node scripts/learn-title.cjs "<exact job title>" <variant-id> [--note "why"]. 'learned' is exact-title (case-insensitive, punctuation ignored); the keyword lists in config/search-spec.json -> resumeVariants handle everything else.
